title: Lunch on the Bench
objectives_ko: 두 글자 ch 가 한 소리 /tʃ/ 를 낸다는 것을 알고 말한다
ch 단어 6개(chin chip chop chess bench lunch)를 소리를 이어 읽고 그림과 잇고 쓴다
사이트워드 they, was를 보고 읽고, 배운 단어로 된 문장 4개를 읽는다

workbook.title: C. Read and circle.  D. Trace the sentence.

sentences.text: The lunch is on the bench.
A chip was on my chin!

story.title: Lunch on the Bench

panels.desc: Lunch time in a sunny clearing of the Pair Forest. The friends' red lunch box was sitting open on a green wooden bench, but a little striped chipmunk is running off with it toward a round door in a big hollow log; on the door the two letters c and h are carved — the ONLY text allowed in the picture. The door is snapping shut behind the chipmunk's tail. Bun reaches out in shock; Hedgie drops a napkin; Pip says the two letters apart, puzzled; Pim and Pam sit side by side on the back of the bench. Hidden in the picture: the green bench, a chess board with black and white pieces on a tree stump, a small axe stuck in a chopped log. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 벤치 위 점심 도시락을 다람쥐가 들고 c·h 가 새겨진 통나무 문 안으로 쏙! 문이 쾅 닫혀요. 핍은 "크… 흐…"

panels.desc: Pim and Pam stand side by side on the log and say the sound together, puffing like a tiny train, and the round log door pops open with a puff of sparkles. Inside the hollow log sits the chipmunk, crunching golden potato chips from the red lunch box, one chip stuck on its chin. Beads holds up a string of three beads and clicks them; Bun and Hedgie peek in. Hidden in the picture: golden potato chips, the chip on the chipmunk's chin, the red lunch box.
panels.ko: 핌과 팜이 함께 /tʃ/! 칙칙폭폭 기차처럼 소리를 내자 통나무 문이 펑! 안에서 다람쥐가 감자칩을 와작와작, 턱에 칩이 붙었어요.

panels.desc: Pip hops into the hollow log and tries to say the word to the chipmunk, beak open, the sounds coming out as separate little puffs; two baby chipmunks pop up beside the first one, each hugging a potato chip; Hedgie kneels and kindly holds out one more chip; Bun laughs. Hidden in the picture: the potato chips, the red lunch box, the chipmunk's chin.

lines.ko: 크… 흐… 입? 크… 흐… 입?

panels.ko: 핍은 또 "크… 흐… 입?" 아기 다람쥐 둘이 더 나와요. 다람쥐들은 감자칩을 좋아해요!

panels.desc: Everyone shares lunch together on the long green bench: the three chipmunks, Bun, Hedgie, Beads, Pim and Pam. A chess game waits on a stump. Above them, Grumble lets down a little basket on a string from his branch, peeking over the edge with a sleepy, hopeful face; Bun drops a chip into the basket. Pip sits beside the chess board. Hidden in the picture: the bench, the chess board, the chopped log with the axe, the lunch box.
panels.ko: 모두 벤치에 앉아 점심을 나눠요. 나무 위 그럼블이 바구니를 내려요. "감자칩? 내 거?" 번이 칩 하나를 넣어 줘요.

story.synopsis_ko: 다람쥐가 점심 도시락을 들고 c·h 통나무 문 안으로 숨었어요. 핌과 팜이 함께 /tʃ/! 문이 열리자 다람쥐들이 감자칩을 먹고 있어요. 모두 벤치에서 점심을 나누고, 나무 위 그럼블도 바구니를 내려 감자칩을 받아요.
story.so_far_ko: 그럼블의 "쉿!"이 바로 sh 소리라서 첫 번째 문이 열렸어요.
story.goal_ko: ch /tʃ/ 를 말해 통나무 문을 열고 점심을 되찾아요.

Gentle picture-book animation: the twin bluebirds puff the sound together and the round log door pops open with sparkles; inside, the chipmunk crunches potato chips with a chip stuck on its chin and blinks at the friends. Camera still. Funny, child-friendly. No text.
